name: io.github.Servosity/wordpress-mcp
title: WordPress MCP
description: Publish and manage WordPress pages, posts, media

environmentVariables.name: WORDPRESS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Wordpress API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: WORDPRESS_BASIC_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: Set the WORDPRESS_BASIC_AUTH credential for the WordPress MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: WORDPRESS_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the default client profile.

environmentVariables.name: WORDPRESS_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent sent on WordPress requests. Leave blank to use the built-in User-Agent.
